1: AS AMENDED, SO AS TO ADD A NEW SECTION 25 TO BE ENTITLED "CONTROL OF MASSGATHERINGS"; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES. AMENDMENT TO CHAPTER 25 SECTION B NUMBER 9 9. Mass Gathering. Any event likely to attract one thousand (1,000) or more persons and to continue for four (4) consecutive or more hours; All Ordinances or parts of Ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed. This Ordinance shall be effective on the ___day ______ 2022. SO ORDAINED this ____ day of ____________ 2022. Jay Andrews, Mayor of the City of Roberta
